# ChannelScale

> Record once. Show up everywhere. Done-for-you podcast production: you hit record, we handle everything after.

ChannelScale is a done-for-you podcast production studio founded by Carter Wells. Clients record their show and upload the raw files. ChannelScale edits every episode, packages it for YouTube, cuts and captions 20-30 clips a month, and posts everything across platforms.

## Who It Is For
Podcasts and video shows that already earn money, directly or by bringing in clients for the business behind them. Interview, co-hosted, solo and talking-head shows all get the same deliverable.

## What Clients Get Each Month
- **4 full episode edits**: camera sync, multicam cut, audio cleanup, color correction.
- **YouTube packaging**: researched title, custom thumbnail, chapters, description and tags on every upload.
- **20-30 clips**: vertical, captioned, posted to YouTube Shorts, Instagram, TikTok, X and Facebook.
- **Posting and scheduling** across every platform.
- **Back catalog relaunch** during month one.
- **Monthly report** on views, watch time, click-through rate and what changes next.

## Pricing
Partnerships start at $4,000 per month on a six-month term. Quotes depend on episode length, camera count and posting platforms.

## Guarantees
- First edited episode back within 7 days of receiving files, or that month is free.
- Full refund if requested within the first 7 days.

## Track Record
- 1.7B+ combined YouTube views, 3.2M+ YouTube subscribers managed.
- Counterpoint Studios: debate podcast built from zero since March 2025 to 38K+ subscribers, 8.6M+ lifetime views and 1.8M+ hours of watch time.
- @GiveMeAnAnswer: 10K to 3.5M views on repackaged footage.
- Bowmar Bowhunting: 30K to 612K views per upload.
- Founder background: BA in Cinema; produced for the PGA Tour, Iowa Hawkeye Football and the NWSL.
